 AC Milan G. Ramos S. Chukwueze Serie A Updates on the condition of AC Milan’s two injured players: all the latest.
 Injuries to AC Milan players Gonçalo Ramos and Samu Chukwueze have complicated the club's plans in recent hours ahead of Serie A and the Europa League . The club have issued an update on both players: 
 Gonçalo Ramos 
 Ramos underwent scans after feeling fatigue in his left calf. The MRI scan came back clear. 
 Samuel Chukwueze 
 Chukwueze saw a specialist about the problem with his left hip and has begun a course of injections. He is scheduled for a further examination to assess his progress in 10 to 15 days. 
 Amorim’s words
 Manager Ruben Amorim also addressed the injuries ahead of the match against Bournemouth: " I'm not sure about Chukwueze. His injury is different from Ramos's. For Ramos, it's a minor issue, just a precaution . He only felt a little muscle stiffness. But we're prepared" 
 Injuries
 Milan's treatment room is filling up. Samuel Chukwueze felt pain in his left hip after the win against Atalanta and will undergo a specialist examination in the coming hours. He could face a significant spell out. Matteo Gabbia, who has an injury to a thigh flexor muscle with partial tendon involvement, and Alexis Saelemaekers , who has undergone ankle surgery, will not return until 2027.
